speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment, can you tell me if you have experienced any recent fevers, night sweats, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your age and symptoms, I need to check for occult bleeding or malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Fecal Occult Blood Test.

speaker: Doctor
text: You have a significantly elevated white blood cell count and anemia, which raises concern for a hematologic malignancy or chronic infection. Do you have any swollen lymph nodes, bone pain, or a history of tick bites or travel to endemic areas for Lyme disease?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any palpable lymph nodes, bone pain, or abdominal fullness that might suggest organ enlargement? I also need to know if you have experienced any night sweats or recent fevers.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Patient denies any chronic illnesses or prior hospitalizations. Social history: Retired engineer; denies tobacco use or illicit drug use. Drinks alcohol socially.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your age, significant leukocytosis, and anemia, I am concerned for a hematologic malignancy such as leukemia. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral Blood Smear

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Peripheral Blood Smear: Increased lymphocytes with smudge cells

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of smudge cells on the peripheral smear is highly characteristic of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL). DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
